channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Iran: Kormeerayaasha IAEA ayaa dhowaan booqday xarunta nukliyeerka ee Bushehr
item.description: Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran Esmaeil Baghaei ayaa sheegay in kormeerayaasha Hay'adda Tamarta Nukliyeerka Adduunka (IAEA) ay dhowaan booqdeen warshadda korontada nukliyeerka ee Bushehr, isagoo ku tilmaamay caddayn in iskaashiga hay'addu uu socdo, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Bundesliga: Bayer Leverkusen oo 2-1 ku garaacday 1. FC Köln
item.description: Bayer Leverkusen ayaa 2-1 ku garaacday 1. FC Köln kulankii Bundesliga (wareegga 9aad) ee 8 Nofembar, garoonka RheinEnergieStadion.

item.title: Bundesliga: Hoffenheim oo 2-1 ku garaacday Schalke 04
item.description: Hoffenheim ayaa 2-1 ku garaacday Schalke 04 kulankii Bundesliga (wareegga 9aad) ee 8 Nofembar, garoonka SNP Arena.

item.title: Bundesliga: SC Freiburg oo 2-0 ku garaacday Union Berlin
item.description: SC Freiburg ayaa 2-0 ku garaacday Union Berlin kulankii Bundesliga (wareegga 9aad) ee 8 Nofembar, garoonka Europa-Park Stadion.

item.title: Guterres: Adduunku wuxuu galay 'xilli cimilo xad-dhaaf ah'
item.description: Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay Antonio Guterres ayaa Isniinta ugu baaqay hoggaamiyeyaasha ku shiraya COP31 ee Antalya inay dardargeliyaan dhimista qiiqa iyo ka guurista shidaalka, isagoo sheegay in adduunku galay 'xilli cusub oo cimilo xad-dhaaf ah', sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Tanzania iyo WTTC oo London ka wada hadlay soo jiidashada maalgashi dalxiis
item.description: Wasiirka Kheyraadka Dabiiciga iyo Dalxiiska Tanzania Dr Ashatu Kijaji ayaa London kula kulmay guddoomiyaha Golaha Safarka iyo Dalxiiska Adduunka (WTTC) Manfredi Lefebvre, waxayna ka wada hadleen maalgashiga dalxiiska iyo kordhinta booqdayaasha caalamiga ah, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.

item.title: IGAD iyo Jarmalka oo Jabuuti ku yeeshay wadahadalkooda sannadlaha ah ee iskaashiga
item.description: Ururka IGAD iyo dowladda Jarmalka ayaa Isniinta xarunta IGAD ee Jabuuti ku qabtay wadahadalkooda iskaashi ee sannadlaha ah, waxayna dib u xaqiijiyeen ballanqaadkooda nabadda, adkaysiga iyo is-dhexgalka gobolka Geeska Afrika, sida uu sheegay war ka soo baxay IGAD. Wafdiga IGAD waxaa hoggaaminayay Xoghayaha Fulinta Dr Workneh Gebeyehu.

item.title: Itoobiya oo goob gaar ah ka furatay shirka COP31 ee Antalya iyadoo u diyaar garoobaysa martigelinta COP32
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya Gedion Timothewos iyo Wasiirka Maaliyadda Fitsum Assefa ayaa shirka cimilada COP31 ee Antalya, Turkiga, ka furay goobta Itoobiya, iyadoo dalku diyaar u yahay inuu 2027 martigeliyo COP32, sida ay werisay Fana oo xiriir la leh dowladda.

item.title: Guddoomiye Wetang'ula oo xoojiyay ololaha dib-u-doorashada Ruto ee galbeedka Kenya
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Qaranka Kenya Moses Wetang'ula ayaa dadka galbeedka Kenya ugu baaqay inay taageeraan Madaxweyne William Ruto oo u taagan xilli labaad doorashada guud ee 2027, isagoo sheegay in xulafadaasi ay xoojin doonto saameynta gobolka ee dowladda, sida ay werisay KBC.

item.title: Nairobi oo la kordhiyay qaybinta biyaha, kaddib markii biyaha xarafka Ndakaini hoos u dhaceen
item.description: Shirkadda Biyaha iyo Bullaacadaha Magaalada Nairobi ayaa sheegtay in qaybinta biyaha la kordhiyay, maadaama wax-soo-saarka xarumaha Ngethu iyo Kigoro uu hoos u dhacay 35%, kaddib markii biyaha xarafka Ndakaini yaraadeen; waxaa saameyn doonta qaybo ka mid ah Kiambu, Kajiado iyo Machakos, sida ay werisay KBC.

item.title: Museveni oo jaamacadaha Uganda ugu baaqay inay mudnaanta siiyaan tababarka xirfadaha
item.description: Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni ayaa jaamacadaha Uganda ugu baaqay inay xoogga saaraan tababarka xirfadaha gacanta si ardaydu u abuuraan shaqooyin, isagoo sheegay in shaqo-la'aantu ay tahay caqabad weyn; khudbadda waxaa jaamacadda Bugema ka akhrisay Ra'iisul Wasaare Robinah Nabbanja, sida ay werisay Nile Post.

item.title: Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania oo dammaanad amaah ah ku furay 2.1 tirilyan oo shilin
item.description: Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania (BoT) ayaa sheegay inuu bixiyay dammaanado amaah oo dhan 1.6 tirilyan oo shilin, kuwaas oo ganacsatada u fududeeyay amaah dhan 2.1 tirilyan oo shilin oo qaybo kala duwan oo dhaqaalaha ah, sida ay werisay Daily News oo dowladdu leedahay.

item.title: Mareykanka iyo Jasiiradaha Baasifigga oo martigelin doona Koobka Adduunka Rugby League 2030
item.description: Hay'adda maamusha Rugby League ee caalamka (IRL) ayaa go'aamisay in Koobka Adduunka ee 2030 lagu qabto Mareykanka iyo Jasiiradaha Baasifigga, iyadoo 5-ta magaalo ee martigelinaysa aan weli la shaacin, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Holland: Ciyaarta Vitesse iyo De Graafschap oo la joojiyay kadib markii taageerayaal xireen baska kooxdooda
item.description: Ciyaar heerka labaad ee Holland oo u dhaxaysay Vitesse Arnhem iyo De Graafschap ayaa la joojiyay kadib markii taageerayaasha De Graafschap ay ka hor istaageen baska kooxdooda in uu u ambabaxo ciyaarta, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Booliska Kenya oo qabtay 454 kg oo daroogada methamphetamine ah
item.description: Booliska Kenya ayaa sheegay in ay xeebta dalka ku qabteen 454 kg oo methamphetamine ah oo lagu qiimeeyay $27 milyan, iyagoo xiray 3 qof oo looga shakisan yahay, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay in uu Shiinaha kula kulmi doono Putin iyo Xi
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in uu filayo in uu kula kulmo Vladimir Putin iyo Xi Jinping shirka Aasiya iyo Baasifigga ee Shenzhen 18–19 November, isagoo sheegay in ay ka wada hadli doonaan hub ka dhigista nukliyeerka iyo joojinta dagaalka Iran, sida ay werisay Euronews.

item.title: Huckabee: Gargaarka Mareykanka ee Israel si deg-deg ah looma joojin doono
item.description: Safiirka Mareykanka ee Israel Mike Huckabee ayaa sheegay in gargaarka $4 bilyan ee Washington aan si kedis ah loo joojin doonin, maadaama joojintiisu ay u baahan tahay ogolaanshaha Congress-ka, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today oo soo xigatay i24NEWS.

item.title: Ururka Qareennada Kenya oo dalbaday xisaabtan iyadoo qareen Abshir uu weli maqan yahay
item.description: Ururka Qareennada Kenya (LSK) ayaa ku baaqay in hay'adaha amnigu ay sheegaan meesha uu ku sugan yahay qareen Abshir Ahmedsadak Abdi, waxaana uu ku dhawaaqay bannaanbaxyo cusub Talaadada, maalinta Maxkamadda Sare ee Milimani ay go'aan ka gaari doonto kiiska habeas corpus.

item.title: Tanzania: STAMICO oo Dodoma ka furtay warshad shidaal nadiif ah oo ku kacday 3.7 bilyan oo shilin
item.description: Shirkadda Macdanta ee Dowladda Tanzania (STAMICO) ayaa magaalada Dodoma ka furtay warshadda Rafiki Briquettes oo ku kacday 3.7 bilyan oo shilin, si loo yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta qoryaha iyo dhuxusha, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.

item.title: Krakow: Ninkii looga shakiyay rasaasta dishay 6 qof oo isbitaal ku geeriyooday
item.description: Booliska Poland ayaa sheegay in ninka 24 jirka ah ee looga shakiyay in uu dilay ugu yaraan 6 qof rasaas ka dhacday bartamaha Krakow Sabtidii uu isbitaalka ku dhintay subaxnimadii Isniinta, sida ay werisay BBC.

item.title: TikTok oo Kenya ka tirtirtay in ka badan 750,000 oo muuqaal
item.description: Shirkadda TikTok ayaa sheegtay in ay Kenya ka saartay 750,185 muuqaal oo ku xadgudbay xeerarkeeda bulshada intii u dhexeysay April ilaa June 2026, sida ay werisay Capital FM.

item.title: Faa'iidada Vodacom Tanzania oo kor u kacday 183 boqolkiiba
item.description: Shirkadda Vodacom Tanzania ayaa sheegtay in faa'iidadeeda saafiga ah ay gaartay 117.8 bilyan oo shilin lixdii bilood ee ku egeyd September 2026, halka dakhliga adeegyadu uu 20.8 boqolkiiba kor ugu kacay 1.067 tirilyan oo shilin, sida ay werisay The Citizen.

item.title: Suuqyada saamiyada Aasiya oo soo kabtay kadib hoos u dhacii shirkadaha tiknoolajiyadda
item.description: Suuqyada saamiyada Aasiya ayaa Isniinta kor u kacay kadib hoos u dhacii toddobaadkii hore ee la xiriiray guusha Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe ee Mareykanka, iyadoo Nikkei 225 ee Tokyo uu kor u kacay 3.45%, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Rubio: Dagaalka Iran lama jecla, laakiin wuxuu ahaa lagama maarmaan si loo joojiyo khatarta nukliyeerka
item.description: Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio ayaa Axaddii sheegay in Madaxweyne Trump uu dagaalka Iran u qaaday si uu adduunka uga ilaaliyo hamiga nukliyeerka Tehran, isagoo tilmaamay in wada-hadallada aysan ku dhowayn horumar, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Mexico oo xirtay nin lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu hoggaamiye sare ka yahay kooxda daroogada ee Jalisco
item.description: Ciidamada badda Mexico ayaa sheegay in Axaddii magaalada Zapopan lagu qabtay Rafael Alvarez oo loo yaqaan "R2", kaas oo lagu tuhunsan yahay inuu madax u yahay qayb ka mid ah kooxda CJNG, iyadoo la adeegsaday xog ay bixisay hay'adda DEA ee Mareykanka, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Magaalada New Delhi oo ay qabsatay qiiq sun ah kadib dabbaaldegga Diwali
item.description: Daruur qiiq iyo wasakh ah ayaa subaxnimadii Isniinta daboolay caasimadda Hindiya kadib markii dadku ay Axaddii ridayeen rashka dabbaaldegga Diwali, iyadoo heerka tayada hawada (AQI) uu dhaafay 350 meelo badan oo magaalada ah, sida ay werisay AP.

item.title: Weerar drone ah oo lagu qaaday aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Kirishi ee Ruushka
item.description: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Leningrad, Aleksandr Drozdenko, ayaa Telegram ku sheegay in xalay drone-yo ay weerareen aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Kirishi, oo qiyaastii 150 km u jirta St. Petersburg, isla markaana 113 drone la soo riday, sida ay werisay wakaaladda TT ee Sweden Herald.

item.title: Moldova oo daah-furtay khad koronto oo cusub oo ku xiran Romania si ay uga yareyso ku tiirsanaanta Ruushka
item.description: Moldova ayaa Axaddii si rasmi ah u daah-furtay khad koronto oo cusub oo dalka ku xiraya Romania iyo shabakadda korontada Yurub, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la yareeyo ku tiirsanaanta tamarta Ruushka.

item.title: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda G7 oo Paris ku kulmaya; Yurub ayaa Mareykanka kala hadli doonta Ukraine iyo Iran
item.description: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda kooxda G7 ayaa Isniinta Paris ka bilaabaya wadahadallo socon doona 2 maalmood, iyadoo France 24 ay sheegtay in dalalka Yurub ay Mareykanka ku cadaadin doonaan inuu raadiyo xal caddaalad ah oo Ukraine ah, kana fogaado weerarro cusub oo Iran lagu qaado.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay in jagada afhayeenka uu Dana White u soo bandhigay ay ahayd kaftan
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa wargeyska The New York Times u sheegay in soo bandhiggii uu jagada afhayeenka Aqalka Cad u soo bandhigay madaxa UFC Dana White uusan ahayn mid dhab ah, isagoo yiri "I was just kidding", sida ay werisay Sweden Herald oo soo xiganaysa wakaaladda TT.
